renderer: deterministic inline SVG alternating pressure block
primitiveBudget: one generated compound SVG body, one structural void, two fixed pressure banks, six produced strata, four material modes, and four liftable loads
commitThreshold: a held pulse from a bank followed by release, alternating sides
memoryRule: the pressure banks stay exact while the central body, void, and strata change as alternating loads accumulate
interactionRule: pointer or touch holds left/right bank; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight or Space hold; Enter uses deterministic alternating pulse; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: sparse counterform tiles, compound topology skin, and pressure bands -> one singular cutaway SVG block with produced strata
compositionRupture: distributed witness field, perimeter membrane, and oblique loom -> central vertical weight between two fixed banks
encounterRupture: two-site handoff, edge escape, and ordered crossing -> sustained hold-and-release with alternating sides
temporalRupture: remote receiver memory -> local material cross-sections that inherit prior loads
mediumRupture: compound islands, skin apertures, and filled bands -> one even-odd cutaway body plus evolving SVG paths
changedRule: Material resistance becomes a local production rule: a held pulse must alternate sides, then changes the next SVG cross-section of the central block while the pressed banks remain exact.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one singular mineral-blue block with a deep central void, two fixed coloured banks, and six strata. Four alternating loads change actual body, void, and layer geometry as crease, lean, cleave, and settle.
falsifier: Delete if a short or repeated-side pulse commits, if the banks deform, if body change is only colour or readout, if later loads overwrite earlier geometry, or if the blind object reads as a generic pressure diagram.
deletionCondition: Delete v046 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the local pressure block from v043-v045 or if waiting is only explanatory prose attached to a button.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
